test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum of money amounts to Rs. 2,613 in 6 years at 5% simple interest per annum. In how many years will it amount to Rs. 3,015 at the same rate?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Principle amount 'P' in 'n' years at 'r'% interest rate per annum = P+(Ptimes r times n)/(100)

**Calculation:**

For 6 years, 2613=P+(Ptimes 5 times 6)/(100)<
